target_test.name: test_non_ascii_character
body: # In Java, getBytes(US_ASCII) replaces non-ASCII chars with '?'
# We need to encode the string to bytes first, handling non-ASCII chars
# The non-ASCII characters (À and \u0100) will be outside the decoding table
# and will be ignored as INVALID_BYTE
# For "Zg=À=", the À character (0xC0 in Latin-1) will be ignored
# So it's effectively "Zg==" which decodes to "f"
# Encode as latin-1 to preserve the byte value of À
# For "Zg=\u0100=", the \u0100 character will be encoded as UTF-8
# which produces bytes outside the base64 alphabet, so they're ignored
